title: Task [terminal] table
description: The four raw terminal verbs a task that owns an interactive endpoint declares (docs/design/plugin-boundary-contracts.md, Terminal Operation Surface). Declaring any one member requires all four — a partial table cannot honor every verb the {{terminal "..."}} template helper and plect attach/plect capture promise to resolve. Each member is a Go-template-rendered shell command string; arrays are rejected by requiring string type.

attach.description: Hands the terminal over interactively; receives no operand.

capture.description: Returns a read-only snapshot of the terminal's current contents; receives no operand.

send_text.description: Sends literal text into the terminal; receives the text as its first shell positional parameter ($1).

send_keys.description: Sends a key-combo token (e.g. "Enter") into the terminal; receives the token as its first shell positional parameter ($1).
